apps.localizedDescription:
MeloCafe - Wii U emulator:

This is the code repository of MeloCafe, a Cemu based Wii U emulator that is able to run most Wii U games and homebrew in a playable state.

MeloCafe is currently only available for iOS/iPadOS platforms.

Other relevant repositories::

• Cemu's Community Graphic Packs.

Download & Install:

Just like MeloNX, the Increased Memory Limit Entitlement is needed for the best experience.

Without Increased Memory Limit crashes may occur (especially when using JIT).

Recommended Guide (Plumeimpactor):

SideStore is recommended (optional) for an on-device Sideloader, and should be installed prior performing this install.

• Sideload Application:.

• Open PlumeImpactor > Click Settings > Click Login.
• Login with the same Apple ID you are using for SideStore (or AltStore).

versions.localizedDescription:
• Updated Threaded Interpreter.
• Pre-decode Interpreter Cache.
• Single Core CPU Mode options.
• Guest RAM NSExtension offloading.

• Move Virtual Controller to Safe Area.
• Add No ROMs View.
• Direct Jumping support for the JIT Recompiler.
• Fix Page Fault with older GPUs.
• Make Statistics Overlay Asynchronous.
• Improved Cube map support (#3).
• Fix Controllers with analogue triggers triggering incorrectly.
• UI bug fixes.

Make sure to assign the Universal Script in StikDebug.
